title: Light and life
question: How much does light matter to a Sunbead?
intervention: Make a copy of this dish and paint shade over all of copy B (light × 0.1). Run both for 180 seconds and compare how much carbon the Sunbeads fixed.
predictedTradeoff: Sunbeads in shade fix less carbon from the same air. With less growth they may also use less nutrient.
confounds: Shade is the only setup difference. Sunbeads also depend on nutrient and CO2, which both copies start with in equal amounts. One paired run with one seed.
